# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.5 M9, outlets for legitimacy and public opinion. Generated by gen_m9_outlets.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# BYZ scope. The action's effect: legitimacy for authority.
oe_m9_legit_do = {
    add_legitimacy = -10
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 2 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_m9_legit_cd value = 1 years = 2 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Counts the months of public opinion at 53 or more; 民心所向 from 12 months in a row, gone
# the month the opinion is lower. Then the AI's use of the action.
oe_m9_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_m9_opinion >= 53 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_m9_opin_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_m9_opin_m value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_m9_opin_m add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_m9_opin_m >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_m9_favour } } set_variable = oe_m9_favour }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_m9_opin_m } remove_variable = oe_m9_opin_m }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_m9_favour } remove_variable = oe_m9_favour }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = yes oe_m9_legit_ok = yes legitimacy >= 80 oe_m9_authority < 25 }
        oe_m9_legit_do = yes
    }
}
